title: Bruno Sammaciccia, the Nordics with underground bases, and the Contrari

tellings.quote: There's a case that I cover in Closer Encounters. this guy Bruno Samachicia and his associates um were engaged by these Nordics who had underground bases

plain: In Italy in the 1950s, a man named Bruno Sammaciccia and his associates are said to have been taken up by "Nordics", the name UFO lore gives to tall, human-looking beings, who kept underground bases. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells it on the show as a case he covers in his work Closer Encounters, summarising it without naming the source he drew on, and the story is also tied to a group called the Contrari, which the telling does not explain. If true, it would mean such beings lived hidden beneath the ground and dealt directly with ordinary people.
